import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# List all source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/training_6.csv"
]

# Columns expected in the target schema
target_columns = [
    'Timestamp [ms]',
    'CPU cores',
    'CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]',
    'CPU usage [MHZ]',
    'CPU usage [%]',
    'Memory capacity provisioned [KB]',
    'Memory usage [KB]',
    'Disk read throughput [KB/s]',
    'Disk write throughput [KB/s]',
    'Network received throughput [KB/s]',
    'Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]',
    'Timestamp'
]

# Function to convert Timestamp [ms] to formatted Timestamp string
def convert_timestamp_ms_to_str(ts_ms):
    # Convert milliseconds since epoch to datetime string in format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"
    # Defensive: if ts_ms is NaN or invalid, return empty string
    try:
        ts_int = int(ts_ms)
        dt = datetime.utcfromtimestamp(ts_int / 1000)
        return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    except Exception:
        return ""

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Confirm columns match expected source schema (all have same schema)
    # No transformation needed on columns names since they match target except for 'Timestamp' string column
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have exactly the same schema (except missing the 'Timestamp' string column),
# and the target table schema is the same plus the additional 'Timestamp' string column,
# we can UNION all source tables (concatenate) and then add the 'Timestamp' string column.

# Concatenate all source DataFrames vertically (union)
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Add the 'Timestamp' string column by converting 'Timestamp [ms]'
combined_df['Timestamp'] = combined_df['Timestamp [ms]'].apply(convert_timestamp_ms_to_str)

# Ensure column order matches target schema exactly
combined_df = combined_df[target_columns]

# Enforce data types as per target schema:
# 'Timestamp [ms]': integer
combined_df['Timestamp [ms]'] = combined_df['Timestamp [ms]'].astype('int64')

# 'CPU cores': integer
combined_df['CPU cores'] = combined_df['CPU cores'].astype('int64')

# 'CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]': float
combined_df['CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]'] = combined_df['CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]'].astype('float64')

# 'CPU usage [MHZ]': float
combined_df['CPU usage [MHZ]'] = combined_df['CPU usage [MHZ]'].astype('float64')

# 'CPU usage [%]': float
combined_df['CPU usage [%]'] = combined_df['CPU usage [%]'].astype('float64')

# 'Memory capacity provisioned [KB]': integer
combined_df['Memory capacity provisioned [KB]'] = combined_df['Memory capacity provisioned [KB]'].astype('int64')

# 'Memory usage [KB]': float (source has float, target expects float)
combined_df['Memory usage [KB]'] = combined_df['Memory usage [KB]'].astype('float64')

# 'Disk read throughput [KB/s]': integer
combined_df['Disk read throughput [KB/s]'] = combined_df['Disk read throughput [KB/s]'].astype('int64')

# 'Disk write throughput [KB/s]': float
combined_df['Disk write throughput [KB/s]'] = combined_df['Disk write throughput [KB/s]'].astype('float64')

# 'Network received throughput [KB/s]': float
combined_df['Network received throughput [KB/s]'] = combined_df['Network received throughput [KB/s]'].astype('float64')

# 'Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]': float
combined_df['Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]'] = combined_df['Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]'].astype('float64')

# 'Timestamp': string (already string)

# Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/target_multisource_cot.csv"
combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
